title: Civil Project Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Prammo Realty is a real estate developer focused on redefining luxury and innovation through thoughtfully designed residential and commercial spaces. The company combines contemporary design, advanced technology, and sustainable practices to deliver projects that are both modern and future-ready. Built on integrity and a strong customer-first approach, Prammo Realty has established itself as a trusted name in the industry. With an emphasis on creating enduring communities, the organization prioritizes client needs and aims to deliver iconic developments that leave a lasting legacy for residents and businesses.
  
**Role Description**
The Civil Project Engineer will oversee the planning, design, and execution of civil works for Prammo Realty’s residential and commercial projects. This full-time, on-site role based in Kalyan involves coordinating with architects, contractors, and vendors to ensure that site development, utilities, and infrastructure meet design standards, regulatory requirements, and project timelines. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing and reviewing civil engineering drawings, managing stormwater and drainage solutions, monitoring construction quality, and resolving technical issues at the project site. The Civil Project Engineer will also support cost estimation, material selection, and documentation, while ensuring adherence to safety, sustainability, and compliance standards throughout the project lifecycle.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Civil Engineering and applied civil engineering principles.
* Proficiency in Civil Engineering Design and Site Development for residential and commercial projects.
* Experience with Stormwater Management, drainage design, and related infrastructure planning.
* Knowledge of Quality Control practices for civil construction, materials, and site works.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related field.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and relevant codes.
* Experience with design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, civil design tools) is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with multidisciplinary teams on-site.
* Prior experience in real estate development or building construction projects is an advantage.

title: Manager(LE)-LOSPE
description:
**Professional Experience**

* Good at analytical problem solving, decision making, team leading and interpersonal & communication skill.
* Ability to support and guide multiple Project groups relating to safety management issues.
* Ability to plan & control engineering activities and develop time schedules.
* Ability to work with Project, Customer and Vendor representatives to resolve technical issues.

title: Senior Executive- ZED assessment

Position

Location: Vasai, Maharashtra
  
Employment Type: Full-time | On-site
  
  
Experience:2–5 years
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Assessment & Project Coordination
  
  
\* Coordinate the end-to-end execution of ZED assessment projects.

\* Track assessor performance and assessment completion.
  
\* Ensure timely closure of assigned projects.
  
\* Follow up with relevant stakeholders to resolve delays and bottlenecks.
  
\* Support achievement of monthly and quarterly project targets.
  
  
Process Improvement
  
  
\* Identify operational gaps in the assessment process.
  
\* Suggest improvements to enhance assessment quality, efficiency and turnaround time.
  
\* Support implementation of standardized processes and reporting systems.

\* Graduate / Diploma, preferably in Engineering, Science, Quality, Manufacturing or a related field
  
\* 2–5 years of relevant experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Quality Management Systems, Auditing, Inspection or related areas.
  
\* Good understanding of ISO 9001 / Quality Management Systems.
  
\* Experience in internal audits, process audits, supplier audits or management-system audits will be an advantage.
  
\* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, data management and MIS reporting..
  
\* Strong communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
  
\* Ability to manage multiple assignments and work towards defined targets.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
We are looking for a professional who is:
  
  
\* Quality-conscious and detail-oriented
  
\* Strong in coordination and follow-up
  
\* Good at reviewing documents and identifying gaps
  
\* Comfortable working with data, reports and MIS

\* Willing to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities

Interested candidates are requested to share their \*\*updated CV at:

title: Sr. Civil Engineer (Utilities) - Site
description:
Vacancy Intro
  
  
Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
  
  
What will you do
  
  

* Supervise and monitor execution of utility and civil infrastructure works undertaken by the EPC Contractor to ensure compliance with approved drawings and contract requirements for specifications, scope, quality, health and safety at site.
* Review construction methodologies, work procedures, resource deployment plans, and site execution strategies and provide technical comments and recommendations. Also, review and monitor implementation of approved Method Statements, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Plans, and construction procedures. Identify constructability issues, interface conflicts, site constraints, and design discrepancies and coordinate their resolution with stakeholders.
* Review contractor submissions, including GFC drawings, shop drawings, technical proposals, testing records, and quality documentation.
* Verify setting out, alignment, levels, grades, dimensions, and interfaces between utility networks and adjacent infrastructure. Conduct regular site inspections and surveillance to verify workmanship, construction quality, progress, and compliance with approved standards.
* Monitor construction of Utilities like water distribution systems, sewerage networks, stormwater drainage systems, power distribution corridors, utility crossings, and underground utility infrastructure. Also, supervise construction of GLSRs, ESRs, pump houses, substations, utility buildings, and other associated civil structures.
* Critically review ongoing construction activities, identify deficiencies, deviations, and non-conformities, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Review contractor resource deployment, construction planning, and work fronts to ensure efficient project execution.
* Witness inspections, testing, and commissioning activities for utility networks, reservoirs, structures, and associated infrastructure.
* Monitor project progress, identify delays and risks, and recommend corrective measures to support timely project delivery.
* Coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants, utility agencies, and Client representatives to ensure effective execution and compliance.
* Prepare site supervision reports, technical review comments, compliance assessments, and progress reports, and advise the PMC and Client on technical, quality, and construction-related matters.

Where you will work
  
  
Roha, Raigad.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Qualification & Skills Requirement**

* Bachelor's degree in civil engineering.
* Ability to review engineering drawings, utility layouts, technical specifications, construction methodologies, and contractor submissions.
* Sound understanding of QA/QC procedures, inspection requirements, construction standards, and applicable codes such as BIS, IRC, MoRTH, CPHEEO, and NBC
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi/Marathi.

**Experience Requirement**

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in construction, testing, and commissioning of utility infrastructure.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior role with a PMC, Owner's Engineer or EPC Contractor on large infrastructure or industrial development projects.
* Demonstrated experience in construction and supervision of water distribution systems, sewerage networks, stormwater drainage systems, power distribution infrastructure, and utility corridors. Also, in GLSRs, ESRs, pump houses, substations, utility buildings, and reinforced concrete structures.

What we offer you
  
  

* Market competitive salary
* Experience in an employee friendly work culture
* Insurance cover for self and family
* Social Security
* Paid leaves
* Group Profit Sharing

Are you our new colleague?
  
  
We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. The application process then consists of 1-2 interviews and a possibly assessment. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
  
  
For more information, you can always contact Imran Khan, at imran.khan@haskoning.com.

title: Sr. Power (Transmission and Distribution) Expert
description:
Vacancy Intro
  
  
Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
  
  
What will you do
  
  

* Review and provide recommendations on design documents, calculations, drawings, specifications, equipment datasheets, protection schemes, and technical submissions related to electrical infrastructure.
* Monitor construction and installation of transmission lines, EHV/HV substations, receiving substations, switching stations, distribution substations, underground cable networks, overhead lines, and associated electrical infrastructure.
* Review and monitor construction of electrical facilities including transformers, GIS substations, RMUs, HT/LT distribution systems, capacitor banks, protection systems, SCADA systems, and metering arrangements.
* Ensure compliance with standards and requirements of CEA, CBIP, IS Codes, IEC Standards, Electricity Act, Grid Codes, and applicable utility regulations.
* Coordinate with transmission and distribution utilities, including MSETCL, MSEDCL, STU, CTU, and other statutory authorities for approvals, clearances, inspections, energisation, and system integration.
* Review EPC Contractor submissions related to load assessment, power demand, network planning, redundancy requirements, reliability studies, fault calculations, protection coordination, and power quality analysis.
* Monitor procurement, manufacturing, factory testing, inspection, transportation, installation, and commissioning of major electrical equipment and materials.
* Witness and review Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), pre-commissioning tests, relay testing, transformer testing, cable testing, and system performance tests.
* Monitor contractor compliance with approved construction methodologies, quality plans, testing procedures, safety requirements, and commissioning protocols.
* Review project schedules and monitor progress of electrical works, identifying potential delays, interface issues, and implementation risks.
* Coordinate with civil, mechanical, utility, ICT, and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems with overall project infrastructure.
* Review technical deviations, variation proposals, change requests, and value engineering proposals submitted by the EPC Contractor and assess their impact on performance, reliability, and lifecycle cost.
* Monitor commissioning, energisation, reliability testing, and performance demonstration of transmission and distribution assets and verify achievement of design intent and contractual performance requirements.
* Prepare technical review reports, progress assessments, risk registers, and recommendations for PMC and Client management regarding project status, compliance, risks, and corrective actions.
* Support implementation of renewable energy, smart utility, digital monitoring, and centralized control systems, while advising the Client on technical, operational, reliability, and project delivery risks.

Where you will work
  
  
Raigad, Roha.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Qualification & Skills Requirement**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering.
* Master's Degree in Power Systems Engineering or Electrical Power Engineering shall be preferred.
* Professional certification in Power Systems, Project Management, or Electrical Utility Engineering shall be desirable.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

**Experience Requirement**

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in construction, testing, and commissioning of electrical transmission and distribution infrastructure.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior role with a PMC, Owner's Engineer or EPC Contractor on large infrastructure or industrial development projects.
* Demonstrated experience in EHV/HV substations, receiving stations, transmission lines, distribution networks, underground cable systems, and electrical utility infrastructure.
* Proven experience in utility coordination, obtaining statutory approvals, power evacuation systems, grid connectivity, system integration, and energization activities.
* Experience in reviewing electrical designs, conducting technical evaluations, overseeing testing and commissioning, and managing contractor performance for large industrial, urban infrastructure, or utility projects.

title: VillageReach recrute senior program manager - roha (rapid response outreach & humanitarian action)
description:
VillageReach transforme la prestation des soins de santé pour atteindre tout le monde. Nous sommes orientés par une vision d'un monde où chaque personne dispose des soins de santé nécessaires pour s’épanouir.
 **VillageReach** 
 collabore avec les gouvernements, le secteur privé, les partenaires et les communautés pour bâtir des systèmes de soins de santé primaires réactifs qui fournissent des produits et services de santé aux communautés les plus défavorisées. En tant qu'organisation locale et connectée mondialement, opérant à travers l'Afrique, l'objectif principal de VillageReach est de réduire les inégalités d'accès aux soins de santé primaires de qualité pour 350 millions de personnes d'ici 2030\.
   

  

 Depuis 2015, VillageReach collabore avec le gouvernement de la
 **RDC** 
 , à travers son ministère de la santé publique hygiène et prévoyance sociale et ses programmes spécifiques, pour relever les défis des systèmes de santé afin d'améliorer la livraison des vaccins au dernier kilomètre via la prochaine génération de chaîne d'approvisionnement (NGCA), le transport de drones externalisés pour la distribution de produits de santé, l'engagement du secteur privé, la coordination et le plaidoyer des investissements dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement (SCICA), l'engagement communautaire centré sur la polio axé sur le genre, le transport intégré des échantillons, le renforcement de la vaccination de routine grâce à des stratégies vaccinales spéciales et une intensification périodique de la vaccination de routine (PIRI) et, dans les milieux humanitaires, de l'assistance technique aux programmes de vaccination et du soutien financier à la réponse rapide à l'épidémie de polio.
   

  

 À l'échelle mondiale, VillageReach opère sous la direction et la supervision du Conseil d’Administration. Le Conseil fixe la mission de base, les objectifs et les stratégies de l'organisation et la guide dans leur poursuite en adoptant, entre autres, des politiques solides de gouvernance et de gestion financière et en s'assurant que l'organisation dispose de ressources suffisantes pour faire avancer sa mission.

title: Section Manager Quality
description:
**About Us**
 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**1**
* Receiving Inspection of brought out components
+ Plan, control \& monitor entire day to day activity of function
+ Mentor \& guide a team of skilled technicians
+ New supplier / component qualification, performance evaluation \& drive improvement actions
+ Engineering change control


**2**
* Gauge calibration \& design (Mechanical \+ electrical) :
+ Plan , control \& ensure compliance of organization wide gauge calibration, new gauge design, selection, procurement activities
+ Mentor \& guide at team of skilled technicians at inhouse calibration labs \& also control external calibration agencies
+ Train people with new / additional skill sets


**3**
* Support New Product Release / engineering change activities
+ Review \& revise quality check points / test methods \& equipment’s
+ Coordinate to Prepare \& execute Qualification plan
+ Gate keeper for all new product release projects.


**4**
* Product / Process Certification (UL/CCC/BIS)
+ Understand mandatory product certifications required \& be a single point coordinator for this activity from plant
+ Plan, initiate \& execute product certification activity by involving all stakeholders – take end to end responsibility
+ Ensure ongoing product compliance to these standards \& manage appropriate inclusions as \& when required
+ Manage annual certification audits \& interactions with certification agencies


**5**
* Product Performance \& Chemical Lab management
+ Mentor, guide at team of skilled technicians at refrigerant compressor performance test lab
+ Prepare, monitor \& ensure compliance to daily product performance sampling test plan
+ Initiate \& drive actions on non\-conforming product
+ Test rigs calibration, spares, consumables \& uptime management


**Our Commitment to Our People**
 Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
   

  

 Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

 Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
   

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging**
 At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

* Risk assessment and mitigation.
* Time management and scheduling.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering or a related engineering

**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in project execution and site management.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Omfurn India Ltd. is a leading manufacturer and supplier of pre\-finished wooden doors and modular furniture in India. Established on 13 November 1997, the company brings over 25 years of specialized experience in the furniture and interior solutions industry. Omfurn India Ltd. focuses on quality, durability, and design innovation to meet diverse client requirements. The organization values long\-term partnerships, reliable service, and efficient project delivery across residential, commercial, and institutional segments.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Project Manager role based in Borivali with a hybrid work arrangement, allowing some work\-from\-home flexibility. The Project Manager will oversee end\-to\-end project planning and execution for manufacturing and supply of wooden doors and modular furniture, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and budgets are met. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams and external vendors, tracking material procurement and production schedules, and managing expediting activities to avoid delays. The role involves supervising inspections, monitoring logistics and delivery status, preparing progress reports, and resolving operational issues. The Project Manager will also collaborate with clients to clarify requirements, provide regular updates, and support continuous improvement in project and supply chain processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong project management skills, including Project Management and Expediting, to oversee timelines, resources, and deliverables.
* Candidates should possess experience as an Expeditor and in Inspection to monitor order status, quality checks, and compliance with specifications.
* Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to coordinate shipments, manage inventory flows, and ensure on\-time delivery.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and stakeholder management skills to collaborate with clients, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Relevant experience in manufacturing, furniture, construction, or related industries is highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations management, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency with project management tools and MS Office, and the ability to work in a hybrid environment with minimal supervision.
